questions.text: How can next-token prediction support image generation in an Emu3-style model?

options.A: It predicts continuous pixels directly from a text-only output vocabulary.
options.B: It removes the visual tokenizer and uses a diffusion loss for image tokens.
options.C: It predicts discrete visual codes that an image decoder can render.
options.D: It treats all image tokens as fixed placeholders excluded from the loss.

questions.explanation: A visual tokenizer represents image content as discrete codes; autoregressive next-token prediction can model their sequence, and a visual decoder converts generated codes to pixels.

questions.text: Assume an image tokenizer reduces each spatial dimension by 8. How many tokens represent a 1024×1024 image, excluding separators?
cfg_mix uses u + gamma * (c - u) per logit. For cond=[4, 1], uncond=[2, 3], and gamma=2, what does it return?
questions.explanation: The first logit is 2+2×(4−2)=6; the second is 3+2×(1−3)=−1.
